notes: Partition verified: 10 source and 16 target ids each covered once.
τε is `unrepresented` under rule 70 because the ASV writes one conjunction for τε … καί; a reference comparison will report this as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.

πάντῃ heads on *all* (one root plus a supplied completion, rule 99's quantifier clause) while πανταχοῦ heads on *places* (a compound whose core -χοῦ the ASV glosses, rule 66); the difference is licensed by the two lexemes and not by the parallel English.
